about_the_game:
The gorilla returns - bigger, angrier, and ready to rampage through an all-new city!

Step back into VR and embrace the chaos once again. Smash towering buildings, grab anything you can lift, and throw it across a fully destructible world. The sequel takes everything you loved from the first game - and cranks it up.

🏙️ A Bigger Playground

Welcome to a brand-new city, larger and denser than ever. From shiny skyscrapers to cozy street shops, everything can be destroyed, reduced to rubble, and turned into your weapons of mass chaos.

🎯 More Freedom, More Fun

Go wild in Free Mode, where you can tear the city apart at your own pace, score points, and test your endurance against relentless missiles. Or, unleash your fury by pounding your chest to activate devastating special attacks.

👋 Hello, Little People

This time, the city feels alive. Interact with tiny residents who fall out of cars when you lift them, scatter in fear when you roar, or simply try to escape your rampage. Don’t worry – the game contains no violence, just pure slapstick chaos.

🪜 Step by Step

Progress through the city by unlocking new districts, each filled with unique tasks and surprises. Tear off parts of buildings, hunt for hidden items, or even activate massive structures. (And yes… you can totally try licking that giant ice cream cone.)

🍌 Grow Bigger, Smash Harder

Bananas are back, but now they fuel your power. Eat bananas to grow in size, towering over skyscrapers and turning into an unstoppable force of destruction.

🤝 Go Bananas With Friends

For the first time in the series, you don’t have to rampage alone. Invite your friends or join their chaos in multiplayer mode – smash together, compete for points, or simply watch the city burn.

Gorilla Attack 2: Rampage brings bigger worlds, deeper gameplay, and more ways to go bananas in VR. Whether solo or with friends, it’s time to embrace your inner gorilla and destroy the city like never before.

name: Gorilla Attack 2: Rampage

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 6GB / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset

short_description: Your favorite gorilla (kind of) is back! Smash a massive new city, take on unique challenges, and interact with a fully destructible world. Team up with friends or let them join your chaotic VR adventure!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
